description: This Java source file defines the CommandEndpointConfiguration class, which encapsulates configuration properties for command and control test scenarios within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes an enum for subscriber roles, methods for retrieving endpoint names (legacy or current), and utility methods for addressing commands to devices.

classes.name: CommandEndpointConfiguration
classes.description: Represents configuration settings for command endpoints used in testing scenarios, including subscriber roles and endpoint versions.

classes.name: SubscriberRole
classes.description: Enumerates the different subscriber roles (DEVICE, GATEWAY_FOR_ALL_DEVICES, GATEWAY_FOR_SINGLE_DEVICE) for command subscription.

methods.name: CommandEndpointConfiguration
methods.description: Constructor to initialize configuration with subscriber role and endpoint version flags.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration, summarizing role and endpoints.

methods.name: getSouthboundEndpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the command endpoint name used by devices, based on whether legacy endpoint is used.

methods.name: getSubscriberRole
methods.description: Returns the subscriber role used for command subscriptions.

methods.name: isSubscribeAsGateway
methods.description: Determines if subscribing as a gateway based on the role.

methods.name: isSubscribeAsGatewayForAllDevices
methods.description: Checks if subscription is as a gateway for all devices.

methods.name: isSubscribeAsGatewayForSingleDevice
methods.description: Checks if subscription is as a gateway for a single device.

methods.name: isLegacyNorthboundEndpoint
methods.description: Indicates if the application uses the legacy northbound command endpoint.

methods.name: getNorthboundEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the command endpoint name for application use, based on endpoint version flags.

methods.name: getCommandMessageAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target address for sending command messages to a device.

methods.name: getSenderLinkTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the target address for sender links, considering legacy or current endpoints.
